label: What a skill folder contains
subgoals: List source, build, golden tests and manifest
Build the skill as its own compile unit
Ship known-good inputs, outputs and a QoR baseline

label: What a manifest must say
subgoals: State purpose, inputs and outputs in plain language
Declare tunable parameters with types and ranges
State applicability limits and typical runtime

label: Manifests that mislead
subgoals: Tie each claimed capability to a golden test
Version the manifest together with the code
Flag stale, overclaiming or limit-free manifests
